entries.what: The night before, Elliot packed Hana's first-day lunch (umeboshi rice balls and miso soup in a thermos). Monday morning Hana left for the 7:20 Tule Line to Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Hana got out the door on time with lunch packed and a pump bag ready.

entries.what: Brenda's 8:15 Monday check-in email landed; Elliot read it and left it unanswered while Theo fussed. Judith arrived at 8 and took over the kitchen.
entries.outcome: Email left for later; Judith helping weekdays.

entries.what: First day as the weekday parent: three crib naps logged, Hana's milk rotated into the labeled fridge bin after her first pump.
entries.outcome: Got through the day with all feeds logged.

entries.what: Hana got home around 6 during the witching hour and took Theo while Elliot ate takeout pho.
entries.outcome: Hana's day went fine; both were exhausted.

entries.what: Hana's second day back. Theo refused to nap unless held, and Elliot spent the morning pacing the apartment.
entries.outcome: Only one short crib nap; he wrote 'day 2 solo, the baby is winning 14-0' and asked for no-hold nap tips.

entries.what: Election Day: Elliot took Theo in the stroller to the Vinca Avenue Community Center to vote on council seats and Measure K.
entries.outcome: Ballot cast; the squeaky stroller wheel drew looks.

entries.what: Tuesday night baby loads at the card-only laundry room after Hana got home.
entries.outcome: Two loads done, folded in front of the TV.

entries.what: Elliot planned Thanksgiving with Hana: hosting Judith and Hana's parents at 209, potluck style, on Nov 27.
entries.outcome: Plan set; he began a dish-assignment list.

entries.what: Stroller walk on the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk, Theo asleep by minute twelve.
entries.outcome: Theo napped in the stroller for 40 minutes.

entries.what: Evening witching hour: Elliot hummed the ballpark organ tune until Theo settled around 7:45.
entries.outcome: Crying ended; Hana handled the 5 a.m. feed ahead.

entries.what: Thursday library baby story time at 10:30 with Kaitlyn's group; Theo smiled at the puppet.
entries.outcome: A little adult conversation; another parent mentioned a daycare with openings.

entries.what: During Theo's afternoon nap Elliot built a pros and cons table for two daycare centers, including a column for 'vibe'.
entries.outcome: Table finished; the decision is still open.

entries.what: Hana got home and they looked over the daycare table together after dinner.
entries.outcome: They agreed to tour centers soon.

entries.what: Judith swaddled Theo again for his nap, which Elliot wants to stop. He drafted a text asking her to stop and asked to frame it as Dr. Fong's idea.
entries.outcome: Draft saved, not sent; he said nothing to her.

entries.what: Elliot ordered Phở Bến Thành for dinner on the night of the Flats High fall play, which he skipped. Theo had his evening fuss.
entries.outcome: Fed, quiet evening in.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry at the card-only laundry room.
entries.outcome: Clothes done.

entries.what: Saturday morning trip to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier, buying ingredients for tomorrow's batch cook.
entries.outcome: Got chili ingredients and one new recipe's groceries.

entries.what: Back home, Elliot wrote out the Sunday cooking plan while Theo napped, and Hana handled an afternoon walk.
entries.outcome: Plan for two dishes done.

entries.what: Unit 211's note turned up taped to the door again, and Elliot filed it with the others.
entries.outcome: No reply sent yet.

entries.what: First Sunday batch cook while Theo napped: his chili plus one new pasta dish, portioned into containers.
entries.outcome: Two dishes made for the week; the kitchen was a mess but dinners were covered.

entries.what: Hana ate the first batch for dinner and said it was actually good. Elliot scored it a win.
entries.outcome: Scoreboard: dad 1, dinner 1.

entries.what: He put Theo down in the crib and logged the week's summary in the old spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Week summary done.
